correction_note: The London Bremner edition of Op. 9. Four parts (vl 1, vl 2, vla, vlc), complete and in Gerard order; incipits checked against RISM. RISM catalogues this edition as source 990005866 and records an E-Mn copy at shelfmark M/680-683, very likely this copy. The title page reads 'opera X', which is Bremner's own number; Op. 9 is the normalized modern number the Gerard catalogue uses for these works. No conflict -- publisher opus numbers and Gerard's differ throughout this repertoire.
